name: ridgeline-m1-baseline
what_this_is_not: This is a synthetic-fixture mechanics result. It does not validate real-package performance.
It is not customer evidence, demand evidence, or payment evidence. Counting it as any of those is an automatic-fail condition on docs/validation/SCORECARD.md.

It does not validate hypothesis T1. The fixture's PDFs were generated rather than scanned and its one degraded scan was degraded programmatically; docs/validation/SYNTHETIC_DEAL_ROOM_SPEC.md records that synthetic degradation is kinder than a decade-old fax.
M1 is not validated, not production-ready, and not approved for customer data.

fixture.name: reef-deal-room
fixture.corpus_sha256_method: sha256 over the sorted per-file sha256 list, excluding ground-truth.json, GROUND_TRUTH.md, README.md and outputs/

pipeline.version_meaning: boundary-compatibility version; bumping re-keys every derived span and chunk identifier
pipeline.identifier_scheme: uuid5 derived from namespace + pipeline version + document sha256 + coordinates
pipeline.retrieval: pgvector cosine + postgres FTS, reciprocal rank fusion (k=60)

environment.network_calls_during_run: none for document content; the embedding model is downloaded once from the Hugging Face hub on first use and cached locally

inaccessible_detail.reason: archive is password-protected; supply the password to process
inaccessible_detail.note: registered explicitly and distinguishable from a missing file

corpus.runtime_scope: intake through embedding and indexing, single process, cold page cache, model already downloaded

gates_not_scored.reason: these score the finding layer, which ADR-003 section 4 does not authorize. Reporting a value for them would be inventing a number.

retrieval.metric: recall@12 on planted-finding source documents, queried by finding title only
retrieval.threshold_note: ADR-003 section 6 sets no threshold; this run establishes the baseline
retrieval.scored_note: 19 of 22 planted findings are reachable from the R1 corpus; the other 3 depend on the R2 delta

known_misses_r1.title: Recurring revenue share unsupported as stated
Referenced Exhibit B absent from baseline room
Tax support archive cannot be opened

additional_misses_with_r2.title: Two revenue schedules with different totals
R2 Exhibit B names a different contracting entity

retrieval.miss_interpretation: several misses describe an absence or a cross-document comparison rather than a passage of text, which retrieval alone cannot surface. They are candidates for the finding layer, not necessarily retrieval defects. Failure analysis is pending.

abstention_boundary_not_gated.reason: questions whose subject the corpus covers but whose specific fact is absent. Retrieval cannot distinguish these even in principle; deferred to the finding layer.
examples: how many electric vehicles are in the delivery fleet

verification.clean_install: wheel installed into an empty virtualenv and exercised outside the source checkout
